text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Qatar Emir Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa al-Thani expected to start two-day official visit to Tunis at invitation of President Ben Ali.
- President Ben Ali instructed Finance Minister Mohamed Jeri to multiply effort in preparation of 1998 budget in order to be ready on time.
LE TEMPS - President Ben Ali's speech at summit of Organisation of Africain Unity (OUA) stresses "Perseverance and labour in order to exploit our resources".
- Tunisia elected president of International Managers Organization.
- Mauritanean Health and Social Affairs Minister Mohamed Mahmoud Ould Dahmane visiting Tunisia to chair Tunisia-Mauritania joint health commission.
